bluf: Maritime chokepoint attacks and reciprocal long-range strikes will drive the next week, with shipping insurance spikes and rerouting accelerating. The single biggest risk is sustained or expanded tanker strikes in the Strait of Hormuz plus Houthi ballistic-missile activity that forces wider naval involvement.

forecasts.event: UKMTO or gCaptain reports at least one additional unknown-projectile strike on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz
basis: IRGC interference claims in OSINT chatter
forecasts.watch_for: new UKMTO advisory or satellite imagery post
forecasts.wrong_if: no new strike reports by 07 Oct 18:00 UTC

forecasts.event: Houthi forces claim at least one ballistic-missile strike on a Saudi target with reported casualties
forecasts.wrong_if: no new Houthi ballistic-missile claims by 09 Oct 18:00 UTC

forecasts.event: Ukrainian General Staff or Kyiv Independent reports at least one new long-range drone or missile strike on a Russian air base or oil facility
basis: recent hits on Volodarsk and Khanskaya confirmed
forecasts.watch_for: Ukrainian General Staff release or Russian MoD denial
forecasts.wrong_if: no new Ukrainian deep-strike claims by 09 Oct 18:00 UTC

forecasts.event: At least two additional commercial vessels damaged or sunk by drone strikes off Bulgaria or Romania
basis: Alfa Watan and prior incidents already reported
forecasts.watch_for: new maritime incident reports or crew-missing alerts
forecasts.wrong_if: zero new Black Sea commercial-vessel strikes by 13 Oct 18:00 UTC

forecasts.event: Reuters or Addis/Asmara statements confirm Eritrean military involvement in northern Tigray clashes
basis: TPLF guerrilla-shift debate in local accounts
forecasts.watch_for: first Eritrean or Ethiopian federal statement naming Asmara forces
forecasts.wrong_if: no Eritrean involvement confirmed by 13 Oct 18:00 UTC

forecasts.event: Taiwan MND reports 25 or more PLA aircraft sorties with 15+ median-line crossings in a single day
forecasts.wrong_if: no sortie surge above 20 by 07 Oct 18:00 UTC

forecasts.event: CISA or utility operator reports at least one confirmed operational disruption from SharePoint CVE-2026-65660 exploitation
basis: active exploitation against critical infrastructure flagged
patch lag on exposed on-prem instances
forecasts.watch_for: CISA KEV update or utility outage notice
forecasts.wrong_if: no confirmed CVE-linked disruption by 09 Oct 18:00 UTC

forecasts.event: Polish MOD announces operational status for the new Patriot battery in Lublin region
forecasts.wrong_if: no operational-status announcement by 13 Oct 18:00 UTC

pre_headline.signal: unconfirmed oil-tanker fire and possible sinking off Sochi
pre_headline.why: may trigger Russian Black Sea Fleet response or Ukrainian claim of responsibility

pre_headline.signal: US withdrawal of B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford
pre_headline.why: signals de-escalation or repositioning ahead of potential Hormuz naval tasking

nuclear.why: no new nuclear-related indicators, deployments, or rhetoric appear in any theatre sweep or chatter.
